build.beforeDevCommand: npm run sync:version && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run sync:version && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; connect-src 'self' https: ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; connect-src 'self' https: ws://localhost:* ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'
